knowledge_base_entries.title: Great dodecacronic hexecontahedron reference
knowledge_base_entries.body: Reference entry for the Great dodecacronic hexecontahedron. The listed long-edge length is 2.4 and the listed short-edge length is 1.5, in normalized units.

knowledge_base_entries.title: Great ditrigonal dodecacronic hexecontahedron reference
knowledge_base_entries.body: Reference entry for the Great ditrigonal dodecacronic hexecontahedron. The listed long-edge length is 2.8 and the listed short-edge length is 1.6, in normalized units.
